question.text: The metal's <math><mi>d</mi><mo>-</mo></math> orbitals that are directly facing the ligands in <math><msub><mrow><mi>K</mi></mrow><mrow><mn>3</mn></mrow></msub><mfenced close="]" open="[" separators="|"><mrow><mi>C</mi><mi>o</mi><msub><mrow><mfenced separators="|"><mrow><mi>C</mi><mi>N</mi></mrow></mfenced></mrow><mrow><mn>6</mn></mrow></msub></mrow></mfenced></math> are:

solution.text: Give <math><msub><mrow><mi>K</mi></mrow><mrow><mn>3</mn></mrow></msub><mo>[</mo><mi>C</mi><mi>o</mi><msub><mrow><mfenced separators="|"><mrow><mi>C</mi><mi>N</mi></mrow></mfenced></mrow><mrow><mn>6</mn></mrow></msub><mo>]</mo></math>  is inner orbital complex with hybridization  <math><msup><mrow><mi>d</mi></mrow><mrow><mn>2</mn></mrow></msup><mi>s</mi><msup><mrow><mi>p</mi></mrow><mrow><mn>3</mn></mrow></msup></math>  and octahedral geometry. Ligands are approaching metal along the axes. Hence  <math><msub><mrow><mi>d</mi></mrow><mrow><msup><mrow><mi>x</mi></mrow><mrow><mn>2</mn></mrow></msup><mo>-</mo><msup><mrow><mi>y</mi></mrow><mrow><mn>2</mn></mrow></msup><mo>,</mo></mrow></msub><msub><mrow><mi>d</mi></mrow><mrow><msup><mrow><mi>z</mi></mrow><mrow><mn>2</mn></mrow></msup></mrow></msub></math>  orbitals are directly in front of the ligands.
